question: Did the historical radia5.3.3 linear volumetric slab a/delta2 meet the frozen h/p, residual and parity gates?
stale_reason: Explicit historical5.3.3 artifact adoption; current-main currentness is not asserted. Reviewed constructor-guard change PR538 changes compact_ams.hpp; no original covered hashes are backfilled. Exact release-wheel recertification is deferred to IH release qualification.
milestone: Historical linear volumetric HCurl slab with AMS and BDDC+AMS
claim: Historical radia5.3.3 linear slab a/delta2 met the approved FROZEN01/02/03 campaign; not current-main qualification.

conditions.problem: Linear constant mu=4pi e-7H/m,sigma5e6S/m,delta1e-3m,a2delta,widthdelta/4,H0peak1000A/m; exp(+i omega t); exact tangent trace on all six faces
conditions.mesh: Kuhn tetrahedra m2/4, nx16m,ny=nz=m; p1 HCurl(order1,nograds), p2/3 full HCurl; actual maximal edge/a
conditions.hardware: CPU double precision, two admitted library threads; host-neutral publication

comparison.reference: Canonical haus1989electromagnetic, ISBN9780132490207, section10.7; specialized analytic diffusion fields and flux/power identities
comparison.independence: Analytic formulation is independent of assembled FE; same-matrix sparsecholesky checks algebraic solver parity only; H and B are proportional and not independent detectors

reference.citation: Haus and Melcher, Electromagnetic Fields and Energy (1989), ISBN9780132490207, section10.7; constant-coefficient diffusion specialized to the driven3D extrusion; manual symbolic derivation attached

quantity.name: per-component relative errors of H/B/J, face impedance and Joule power
quantity.definition: Every component is retained separately as metric_code; complete residual/parity and plateau gates are independently audited by entry.py and criterion.json

variables.h_max_over_a: Actual maximal tetrahedron edge over slab half-depth
variables.p: Declared HCurl order mapping; p1 lowest-order, p2/3 full HCurl
variables.metric_code: H=0,B=1,J=2,Z_back=3,Z_front=4,power=5; held fixed within each series

criterion.failure_definition: Any failed FROZEN01/02/03 gate: true iterative/direct residual or A/H/J same-matrix parity>1e-6; non-monotone error; h rate<p-0.5; p2/3 m4 error>0.01; m4 H/B/J adjacent-p ratio>2sqrt(2)/16. Unchanged h or unexplained/roundoff plateau is UNRESOLVED. Functional p ratios and p1 finest errors are recorded only. entry.py retains all102 original gate observations.
